title: Zephyr: OSCORE context from master secret
notes: Implemented and audited RFC 8613 context derivation/lifecycle. Existing coverage includes Appendix C.1/C.2 creation, C.4/C.5/C.7 end-to-end known-answer ciphertext/option vectors (which exercise sender/recipient keys and common IV), client/server roundtrips, bounded static allocation, init/slot/free/wipe, sequence persistence, ID validation, and replay lifecycle. Fixed the remaining edge: reject master_salt==NULL with nonzero master_salt_len, with focused ZTEST. Validation: oscore test TU compiled for nRF52840; oscore_ctx.c compiled successfully with the Attic SDK after downgrading documented Zephyr-4.1-header-only -Werror diagnostics to warnings; git diff --check passed. A pinned v3.7 native_sim attempt reached Zephyr 3.7 but configuration is globally blocked before this module by the unrelated LICHEN_COAP_KEYS<->ZCBOR Kconfig dependency loop in coap/Kconfig. No SCHC or dirty sibling OSCORE packet files touched.
